description: This file defines the Controller class for handling PDF configuration in the SuiteCRM administration module. It extends an abstract controller, constructs a PDF view, and provides a method to save PDF settings via POST requests, responding with JSON if requested via AJAX.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Modules\Administration\PDF\Controller
classes.description: Controller class for handling PDF configuration in the SuiteCRM admin module, extending an abstract controller and providing a save method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller by calling parent constructor with a new PDFView instance.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Handles saving PDF configuration from POST data, outputs JSON response if AJAX, otherwise redirects.
